text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find out where and why the problem happens. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, can help you inspect your code closely. It is also wise to follow a systematic approach: check one part at a time instead of guessing randomly. Another useful strategy is logging. By adding log messages to your code, you can track what the program is doing and spot where things go wrong. With practice, these methods make finding and fixing errors much faster.
